She designs beliefs, cultivates desire, and turns forbidden chemicals into irresistible, sacred miracles. events.title: Demo 0.2 - QOL + Mechanics Updates
events.summary: Demo Update: Faster Tempo, Smoother GameplayThere have been many minor updates to improve the gameplay feel in the demo. The game tempo is now faster, but that does not mean there is less strategy involved. Auto DrawThe draw turn now distributes cards automatically, allowing for smoother gameplay. This also means you can no longer easily adjust card positions during the draw turn to manipulate enemy attack directions, but you can still plan ahead for the next turn. events.title: Demo - Update
events.summary: 14/2/2026Thank you for the support and helpful feedback. After some tests, I’d like to share a few gameplay interaction updates. Important changes:During the draw phase, cards are now dealt automatically to your left and right sides, evenly. You only need to adjust placement when the draw overflows.
